# Methods in Health Data Science with R

This training pathway is designed for clinicians, researchers, PhD students, public health professionals, and data analysts who want to use R for health data analysis.

The courses are delivered online in small cohorts, with applied examples, reproducible workflows, and regular participant support.

## Available Courses

### Applied Biostatistics with R

Foundations of statistical analysis for clinical and biomedical research.

[View course](courses/applied-biostatistics-r.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

### Machine Learning with R

Practical machine learning workflows for health data science using R.

[View course](courses/machine-learning-r.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

### Survival Analysis for Clinical Research with R

Time-to-event analysis, Kaplan-Meier curves, Cox models, prediction, and interpretation.

[View course](courses/survival-analysis-r.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

### Meta-Analysis with R

Systematic review synthesis, effect sizes, heterogeneity, forest plots, and reproducible meta-analysis.

[View course](courses/meta-analysis-r.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

## Registration Workflow

1. Review the course calendar.
2. Complete the pre-registration form.
3. Wait for final registration to open 10 days before the course start.
4. Pay through the PayPal course link.
5. Receive confirmation and cohort communication details by email.

[View calendar](calendar.qmd){.btn .btn-secondary} [Pre-register](register.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
